# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The project is in development and has no supported production release yet.
Security fixes target the main branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report potential vulnerabilities through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/munich-quantum-software/ibm-qdmi-device/security/advisories/new).
Describe the affected version, impact, and steps to reproduce with synthetic
data where possible. Do not include credentials or private backend information.

Do not open a public issue about a potential security vulnerability. See
[GitHub's reporting guide](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
for details about private reports.
